tools.name: markdown_to_pdf
tools.description: Render caller-supplied text Markdown to a real downloadable PDF. Headings, paragraphs and lists; Windows-1252 text only. No images, HTML, fetches or external writes. Returns actual inline file bytes and SHA256.

tools.name: csv_to_xlsx
tools.description: Convert exact caller CSV to a real XLSX spreadsheet with one Data sheet and a SUM totals row. Explicit numericColumns and totalColumns; all other cells are literal strings, never inferred formulas. Returns actual file bytes.

tools.name: xlsx_to_csv
tools.description: Extract every sheet from a caller-supplied base64 XLSX into separate genuine UTF-8 CSV files, preserving sheet names in metadata and cell values. Formula values require existing caches; does not execute formulas. Refuses macros, external links and expansion bombs.

tools.name: zip_text_files
tools.description: Create an exact ZIP of caller-supplied named UTF-8 texts. Preserves bytes and nested safe paths; rejects traversal, duplicate/colliding names and excessive data. No external files or fetches.

tools.name: event_brief_to_ics
tools.description: Create a real iCalendar file from a brief with Start: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM IANA/Zone, Duration: N minutes, Title: text, optionally preceded by a Markdown heading. Resolves timezone to UTC; refuses ambiguous/nonexistent DST times. createdAt must be UTC ISO seconds. Does not add any calendar event.
